meta.title: Game studio
meta.description: Turn one sentence into a complete playable game: an offline single-file HTML5 build or a Cocos Creator 3.8 project (buildable to Web/Android/iOS/HarmonyOS). Both targets share the same gameplay and content, with bot playthrough simulation, Cocos CLI builds and headless-browser screenshot checks. Say "make a tower defense" or "make it in Cocos" to trigger game_forge.
